name: Damped & Driven Harmonic Oscillator (Time + Phase Space) (Custom)
subtitle: 5 cards · 4 presets

cards.title: Time-Domain Wave x(t) for 0 <= t <= T
Phase Portrait (x(t), dx/dt(t)) up to T
Steady-State Limit Cycle (x_p, v_p)
Current State Markers at Time T
Driving Force F0 * cos(wd * t)
cards.code:
if (x < 0.0 || x > T || F0 <= 1e-9) return NAN;
return F0 * cos(wd * x);
